Less than 249 g — fits in your palm

At less than 249 g, Mini 2 weighs about as much as an apple and fits in the palm of your hand — a foldable classic that's effortless to carry.

4K camera on a 3-axis gimbal

A 12MP camera with a 1/2.3-inch CMOS sensor and 24mm f/2.8 lens captures smooth 4K/30fps video and 12MP stills, steadied by a 3-axis motorized gimbal.

31 minutes, 10 km OcuSync 2.0

Up to 31 minutes of flight time and DJI OcuSync 2.0 HD video transmission up to 10 km, with Level 5 wind resistance and 4x digital zoom.
